creativeThesis: Restore two people behind an assumed relationship, then reveal the tests that relationship created.
viewerExperience: An open escape becomes an identity strategy, its literacy and conversation vulnerabilities become understandable, then appearance fails the ownership test; discretionary passage and continuing danger complete the understanding.
emotionalTarget: Respect for deliberate self-emancipation and alert understanding of real risk, without voyeurism or comic costume treatment.
visualThesis: Connect the blank signature line to the bound-hand adaptation, and carry the same onward-travel question through Baltimore demand, appearance-versus-proof and discretionary release. Essential labels are large; authentic source reports remain secondary evidence objects.

decisions.treatment: Narration and intentional silence; no music, train effects, pursuit sounds or fake station ambience.
decisions.rationale: The evidence and strategic constraints carry stakes. Sound implying witnessed action would weaken documentary honesty.

decisions.treatment: Retain exact V2 audio clips, starts and pauses,2447frames/81.5667seconds. Audit measured clip/sentence boundaries and caption timing; no demonstrated reason to shorten or retime. Use motion within existing time.
decisions.rationale: Retain escalation and exact attribution; no forced duration or padded epilogue.

decisions.treatment: Begin with enslavement and the role inversion in the first sentence; visually establish Ellen as apparent master and William as attendant immediately. Transition directly to the signing vulnerability, not a preliminary portrait introduction.
decisions.rationale: Immediate stakes and intrinsic curiosity; no costume gag or premature exhaustive solution.
